notes: POC started but stalled. Summary: Nimbus wanted a turnkey conversational stack to replace an aging rules-based agent. We provisioned a Dedicated trial, validated inference config (batching + KV cache) and provided cost estimates. Initial results looked good - prototype hit latency targets in lab, embeddings quality OK. However: (1) internal engineering cycles vanished (priority shift to infra incident), (2) the Dir of ML Ops (champion) went on leave mid-POC, (3) security raised additional requirements (longer retention + stronger evidence for KMS/HSM integration), and (4) CloudPrompt offered a lower-cost bundled pilot and faster ops support.
